current_point.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法，用于大规模图流数据的分布式划分，通过边分割的方式对图进行划分，以适应图数据的不规则性，为分布式图神经网络训练提供有效的子图划分。
current_point.claim_en: Propose a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation for distributed partitioning of large-scale graph streaming data, which partitions the graph by edge segmentation to adapt to the irregularity of graph data, providing effective subgraph partitioning for distributed graph neural network training.
source_locations: 摘要第二段: DSGNN模型描述中的划分算法
technical_features: 基于边分割的图流划分算法
将原图划分为多个子图
适应图数据的不规则性
technical_features_en: Graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation
Partition the original graph into multiple subgraphs
Adapt to the irregularity of graph data
